job.name: z30e1_evening
job.meaning: вечер, герой расслабленно сидит у окна с чаем, огни города
job.prompt: Evening, the hero sits relaxed on a chair by the window with a mug of tea, city lights and stars outside, cozy calm mood.
job.style: FLAT MINIMALIST 2D animation frame exactly in the style of the attached board: clean geometric shapes, no outlines, soft long shadows, quiet night city of panel apartment blocks with lit windows. Palette: graphite-violet #3A3550 and #24212F, warm window yellow #E8B04B, lime accent #C6F432 (small accents only), white, alarm red #FF5A4E only where danger is described. The hero is THE SAME figure as on the attached board: slim figure with a plain round white head WITHOUT any facial features (no eyes, no mouth), dark navy hoodie, dark trousers, white sneakers. Vertical full-frame scene, main action in the middle of the frame, the top 18% and bottom 25% are calm background (sky, wall, floor) with no important details, because a game panel and subtitles will be overlaid there. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO UI, NO speech bubbles, NO logos in the image.
job.style_qa: плоская минималистичная 2D-анимация в палитре борда (графитово-фиолетовый, жёлтые окна, салатовые акценты), герой с белой круглой головой без лица в тёмно-синей толстовке, смысл соответствует описанию, без надписей, букв, цифр и интерфейса, верх и низ кадра спокойные
